entries.title: Exodus 20:1
segments: ¶And God spoke all these words, saying:

entries.title: Exodus 20:2
segments: "I [am] the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

entries.title: Exodus 20:3
segments: "You shall have no other gods before Me.

entries.title: Exodus 20:4
segments: "You shall not make for yourself a carved image, or any likeness [of anything] that [is] in heaven above, or that [is] in the earth beneath, or that [is] in the water under the earth;

entries.title: Exodus 20:5
segments: you shall not bow down to them nor serve them. For I, the LORD your God, [am] a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children to the third and fourth [generations] of those who hate Me,

entries.title: Exodus 20:6
segments: but showing mercy to thousands, to those who love Me and keep My commandments.

entries.title: Exodus 20:7
segments: "You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain, for the LORD will not hold [him] guiltless who takes His name in vain.

entries.title: Exodus 20:8
segments: "Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.

entries.title: Exodus 20:9
segments: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

entries.title: Exodus 20:10
segments: but the seventh day [is] the Sabbath of the LORD your God. [In it] you shall do no work: you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your cattle, nor your stranger who [is] within your gates.

entries.title: Exodus 20:11
segments: For [in] six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, the sea, and all that [is] in them, and rested the seventh day. Therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day and hallowed it.

entries.title: Exodus 20:12
segments: ¶"Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long upon the land which the LORD your God is giving you.

entries.title: Exodus 20:13
segments: "You shall not murder.

entries.title: Exodus 20:14
segments: "You shall not commit adultery.

entries.title: Exodus 20:15
segments: "You shall not steal.

entries.title: Exodus 20:16
segments: "You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.

entries.title: Exodus 20:17
segments: "You shall not covet your neighbor's house; you shall not covet your neighbor's wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that [is] your neighbor's."

entries.title: Exodus 20:18
segments: ¶Now all the people witnessed the thunderings, the lightning flashes, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking; and when the people saw [it], they trembled and stood afar off.

entries.title: Exodus 20:19
segments: Then they said to Moses, "You speak with us, and we will hear; but let not God speak with us, lest we die."

entries.title: Exodus 20:20
segments: And Moses said to the people, "Do not fear; for God has come to test you, and that His fear may be before you, so that you may not sin."

entries.title: Exodus 20:21
segments: So the people stood afar off, but Moses drew near the thick darkness where God [was].

entries.title: Exodus 20:22
segments: ¶Then the LORD said to Moses, "Thus you shall say to the children of Israel: 'You have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

entries.title: Exodus 20:23
segments: 'You shall not make [anything to be] with Me-gods of silver or gods of gold you shall not make for yourselves.

entries.title: Exodus 20:24
segments: 'An altar of earth you shall make for Me, and you shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your oxen. In every place where I record My name I will come to you, and I will bless you.

entries.title: Exodus 20:25
segments: 'And if you make Me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of hewn stone; for if you use your tool on it, you have profaned it.

entries.title: Exodus 20:26
segments: 'Nor shall you go up by steps to My altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed on it.'
